title: Microstructure, mechanical properties and incipient plasticity of (Ti42.5Zr42.5Nb10Ta5)100-xMox refractory high-entropy alloys
process_description: prepared by vacuum arc melting with Ti, Zr, Nb, Ta, and Mo blocks (purity >99.95 wt%) in specific atomic ratios, re-melted 5 times for homogeneity, and cast into a water-cooled copper mold (10 × 10 × 45 mm).
